title: Record Sufficiency: What a Decision Record Must Preserve When an Unsettled Claim Becomes an Operative Status
abstract: arXiv:2611.23422v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Organisations keep evidence, logs and approvals, but often not the step by which an unsettled claim became an operative status, such as an accepted label or a released image, so later readers cannot tell what the status was allowed to mean. We call a decision record sufficient if it is true and a reader who has only the record and the items it cites can explain the status, bound it, re-derive it and challenge it. From these four uses we argue for ten questions a record must answer, map them onto the author's earlier JSON Schema for decision records (DRK v0.1), and define four mechanical checks. We separate conformance, which the checks decide; adequacy, whether the answers are specific enough to use, which needs a reader; fidelity, which no check on the record decides; and merits, which sufficiency does not require. translated_title: 记录充分性：当未决主张变为生效状态时，决策记录必须保留什么
translated_abstract: 组织机构会保存证据、日志和审批记录，但往往没有保存未决主张变为生效状态（如一个被接受的标签或一个已发布的镜像）的那一步，因此后来的读者无法判断该状态被允许意味着什么。我们将一个决策记录称为“充分的”，如果它是真实的，并且仅凭该记录及其所引用的项目，读者就能够解释该状态、限定其边界、重新推导它并对它提出质疑。基于这四种用途，我们论证了决策记录必须回答的十个问题，将其映射到作者此前提出的决策记录 JSON Schema（DRK v0.1）上，并定义了四项机械检查。我们区分了四个层面：符合性，由这些检查来判定；适当性，即答案是否足够具体以供使用，这需要读者的参与；忠实性，对记录本身的任何检查都无法判定；以及价值，充分性并不要求这一层。在三个合成记录的164个单缺陷变体上，模式验证——DRK v0.1 唯一实现的检查——拒绝了……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文提出“记录充分性”概念——即一个充分的决策记录应使读者仅凭记录及其引用内容，就能解释、限定、重新推导并质疑从未决主张变为生效状态的那个决策步骤——并据此提出记录必须回答的十个问题、映射到DRK v0.1模式、定义四项机械检查，同时区分符合性、适当性、忠实性与价值四个不同层面。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "record sufficiency"—a decision record is sufficient if a reader with only the record and its cited items can explain, bound, re-derive, and challenge how an unsettled claim became an operative status—and derives ten questions such records must answer, maps them onto the DRK v0.1 JSON Schema, defines four mechanical checks, and distinguishes conformance, adequacy, fidelity, and merits.
